title: Question 9
passage:
When does the shoe repair counter close today?
A. At six, an hour earlier than usual. B. It’s beside the flower shop. C. I paid when I dropped them off.
passageZh:
修鞋櫃檯今天幾點打烊？
A. 六點，比平常早一小時。
B. 它在花店旁。
C. 我送鞋來時就付過錢了。
